newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in lacklustre trade, dealers said on Tuesday.
They said most traders were sidelined ahead of the U.S. Treasury's auction of US$17.0 billion in two-year notes later tonight.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments. Some people are waiting for possible direction from tonight's two-year treasury note auction and Wednesday's five-year note auction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent and Wednesday/Thursday rose 1/16 point to 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
Week-fixed was unchanged from Monday's 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/8 6-1/4 percent.
